text: %% Discrete-time feedback simulation for given D[z], G[z] clear; close all; clc Ts = 1; % sampling time (seconds) N = 80; % number of samples k = (0:N-1)'; % sample index numD = [1 @ —(1/9)]; denD = [1 0 —-(1/4) 0]; D = tf(numD, denD, Ts); numG = [1 0 —(1/4)]1; denG = [2 1 -(2/9) -(1/9)]1; G = tf(numG, denG, Ts); | L = minreal(D*G); T = feedback(L, 1); S = feedback(1, L); %y fromr: T_ry=T % y from d: T_dy = GxS T_ry =T; T_dy = minreal(GxS); % u from r: T_ru = DxS % u from d: T_du = -L/(1+L) = -T T_ru = minreal(D%S); T_du = -T; % e fromr: T_re=S % e from d: T_de = -Gx*S T_re =S; T_de = -minreal(Gx*S); % Specify r[k] and d[k] from part (b) r = ones(N,1); % rlk] = 1[k] d = exp(-(k)/20) .x cos(2x%k); % d[k] = e~{-k/20} cos(2k)
